parchment.name: Parchment
parchment.role: Light ground. Official paper, never gray.

flame.name: Flame
flame.role: Non-text accent: BURN moments, display numerals, highlights. Never carries text. ≤10%.

ember.name: Ember
ember.role: Fire at text size: primary buttons, links, labels, hovers.

families.use: Large headlines, 36px and up. Fine, engraved hairlines. Regular + Italic only. No bold exists.
Serif moments from 22–36px: pull quotes, the prophecy, document headings. Regular + Italic only.
Everything functional: body, nav, labels, buttons, sub-brand materials. Weights 400–700 with true italics.

stacks.serifDisplay: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
stacks.serifText: 'DM Serif Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

typography.source: Google Fonts, free for every volunteer, partner, and field team
typography.retired: Proxima Nova, fully retired. Fallbacks: Georgia for the serifs, system sans for DM Sans.

button-hover.name: Button hover
button-hover.rule: Ember deepened ~10%. State-only. Never a palette color.

focus-ring.name: Focus ring
focus-ring.rule: Visible on every interactive element. Never removed.

success-state.name: Success state
success-state.rule: Forms and dashboards only. Never in brand layouts.

error-state.name: Error state
error-state.rule: Forms and dashboards only. Never Flame and never Ember: Ember means "this is the action", and an error is not an action.

warning-state.name: Warning state
warning-state.rule: Forms and dashboards only. Never Flame, which is a celebration colour and reads as one.

disabled-control.name: Disabled control
disabled-control.rule: Low contrast is the message. The only place the muted floor may be crossed.

touch-target.name: Touch target
touch-target.rule: Every control on every surface, however small it is drawn.

success-on-dark.name: Success on dark
success-on-dark.rule: The success state lifted for a dark ground. The light value is 2.4:1 on Midnight and cannot be read there.

error-on-dark.name: Error on dark
error-on-dark.rule: The error state lifted for a dark ground. Passes on Midnight and on Word Blue alike. Still never Flame.

warning-on-dark.name: Warning on dark
warning-on-dark.rule: The warning state lifted for a dark ground. Passes on Midnight and on Word Blue alike.

surface-on-dark.name: Surface on dark
surface-on-dark.rule: Parchment at 5% over Midnight. The raised card and panel ground on a dark page. Any lighter and the accent drops below 4.5:1 on it, which is what fixes this value rather than taste.

accent-on-dark.name: Accent on dark
accent-on-dark.rule: Flame. Ember is 3.3:1 on Midnight and fails, so a text accent on a dark ground is Flame. This is the one place Flame carries text, and §03 records it.

photo-video-scrim.name: Photo/video scrim
photo-video-scrim.rule: Required under any text on imagery (§07).

muted-text.name: Muted text
muted-text.rule: Captions and metadata. Nothing lighter. It fails contrast.

cssVariables.serif-display: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
cssVariables.serif-text: 'DM Serif Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

ink.use: Body text and headings on Parchment or White.

ink-muted.use: Captions, metadata, datelines. Nothing lighter carries text.

ink-soft.use: Placeholder text and inactive labels. Never body copy.

ink-faint.use: Disabled controls only, where low contrast is the message.

rule.use: The hairline. Card borders, table rules, dividers.

rule-soft.use: Secondary dividers and row separators inside a table.

wash.use: Input fills, code backgrounds, loading placeholders.

ink-reversed.use: Body text and headings on Midnight.

ink-reversed-soft.use: Placeholder and inactive labels on Midnight.

wash-light.use: Input fills and raised panels on Midnight.

label.use: DM Sans 600, uppercase, letterspaced .18em. Eyebrows and kickers.

caption.use: DM Sans. Photo captions, metadata, datelines.

body-small.use: DM Sans. Card copy, table cells, secondary text.

body.use: DM Sans. Every extended reading passage.

title-small.use: DM Serif Text. The lowest the serif goes.

title.use: DM Serif Text. Document headings, pull quotes.

title-large.use: DM Serif Text. The prophecy, record openings.

display-large.use: DM Serif Display. Hero headlines only.
